description: Source code defining Express.js routes for managing 'stories' in a web application. Includes endpoints for CRUD operations, searching, filtering, sorting, and pinning stories.

methods.name: GET /
methods.description: Fetches a list of stories with optional search, filter, pagination, and sorting.

methods.name: POST /
methods.description: Creates a new story with data from request body, after validation.

methods.name: GET /:id
methods.description: Retrieves a specific story by ID, only if it belongs to the authenticated user.

methods.name: PUT /:id
methods.description: Updates an existing story identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: DELETE /:id
methods.description: Deletes a story by ID if it belongs to the authenticated user.

methods.name: POST /:id/pin
methods.description: Toggles the pinned status of a specific story.
